name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 72 – Am 14
title: REPORT on a revamped long-term budget for the Union in a changing world
part_text: 72a. Demands that securing the EU’s external borders must be a top priority in the post-2027 budget, with a focus on preventing illegal migration, stopping the activities of human trafficking networks and putting in place an effective return policy; calls for stronger financial and operational support for frontline Member States’ border protection efforts, particularly those most affected by migratory pressures, while ensuring that border security remains the sovereign responsibility of national authorities;
